title: About The Veil Slips Sideways
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around by クリチバの地下鉄 and Well, by KMRU, plus 7 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Veil Slips Sideways: An abstract rose optical field in poster crop, front-facing optical superimposition with separated focal planes and a displaced foreground veil. Split photographic residues into an upper-left brow-and-eye mass and a smaller lower-right mouth-and-cheek mass across broad plum-charcoal silence. After the image was made, the mask pass used geometry and contour candidates to attach source windows to the visible marks.
